definition: For normalized Y, an exact deletion d requires ell_factual-d<=0 because p_deleted(Y)<=1.
scope: Census of completed saved nonzero DT requests, not all rollout tokens or population recall. Each UID/source counted once; all DP views retained.
interpretation: A violation rules out interpreting that d as an exact deletion ratio relative to its recorded factual score. Passing this necessary bound does not prove causal credit accuracy.
numerical_scope: Strict bound relative to stored scores; duplicate sensitivity is not a rigorous FP error bound. No official kernel tolerance is redefined.
minimum_values_not_blanket_rejected: Each completed cohort minimum has implied deleted logp below zero. Retained unchanged; feasibility alone is not an accuracy verdict.
